description: This file defines media-related utility functions and constants for Android shared media, including MIME type mappings for audio and video codecs, and functions to identify Widevine DRM levels.

methods.name: IsWidevineL1
methods.description: Checks if the key system string corresponds to Widevine L1 DRM.

methods.name: IsWidevineL3
methods.description: Checks if the key system string corresponds to Widevine L3 DRM.

methods.name: SupportedAudioCodecToMimeType
methods.description: Maps an audio codec enum to its MIME type string and indicates if it should be played in passthrough mode.

methods.name: SupportedVideoCodecToMimeType
methods.description: Maps a video codec enum to its MIME type string.

methods.name: GetAudioFormatSampleType
methods.description: Returns the Android AudioFormat sample type integer based on the codec and sample type.
